query:copy files to a remote host.text: copy files to a remote host

ansible.builtin.copy::param::src.text:
Parameter: src
Type: path
Required: no
Local path to a file to copy to the remote server. This can be absolute or relative. If path is a directory, it is copied recursively. In this case, if path ends with C(/), only inside contents of that directory are copied to destination. Otherwise, if it does not end with C(/), the directory itself with all contents is copied. This behavior is similar to the C(rsync) command line tool.

ansible.builtin.copy::param::dest.text:
Parameter: dest
Type: path
Required: yes
Remote absolute path where the file should be copied to. If O(src) is a directory, this must be a directory too. If O(dest) is a non-existent path and if either O(dest) ends with C(/) or O(src) is a directory, O(dest) is created. If O(dest) is a relative path, the starting directory is determined by the remote host. If O(src) and O(dest) are files, the parent directory of O(dest) is not created and the task fails if it does not already exist.

ansible.builtin.uri::param::dest.text:
Parameter: dest
Type: path
Required: no
A path of where to download the file to (if desired). If O(dest) is a directory, the basename of the file on the remote server will be used.

ansible.builtin.unarchive::param::src.text:
Parameter: src
Type: path
Required: yes
If O(remote_src=no) (default), local path to archive file to copy to the target server; can be absolute or relative. If O(remote_src=yes), path on the target server to existing archive file to unpack. If O(remote_src=yes) and O(src) contains V(://), the remote machine will download the file from the URL first. (version_added 2.0). This is only for simple cases, for full download support use the M(ansible.builtin.get_url) module.

ansible.builtin.user::param::shell.text:
Parameter: shell
Type: path
Required: no
Optionally set the user's shell. On macOS, before Ansible 2.5, the default shell for non-system users was V(/usr/bin/false). Since Ansible 2.5, the default shell for non-system users on macOS is V(/bin/bash). On other operating systems, the default shell is determined by the underlying tool invoked by this module. See Notes for a per platform list of invoked tools. From Ansible 2.18, the type is changed to I(path) from I(str).
